description: List live departures from one SL stop, soonest first: line, mode, final destination, direction (1 or 2), platform or bus stop letter, minutes or clock time, delay, cancellation and SL's notes. Use it for 'when does the next X leave from Y'. To get from A to B, use plan_trip; for announced track work or broken lifts, use get_disruptions. Real-time data from SL: at most 3 departures per line and direction, up to 3 hours ahead. `towards` matches the final destination only: for a station on the way (e.g. 'mot T-Centralen' from Slussen), leave it out and pick the direction from the results. An unknown siteId gives no departures, not an error.

line.description: Only this line number, e.g. '14' or '43X'

minutes.description: How many minutes ahead to look, at most 180

towards.description: Only departures whose final destination contains this, e.g. 'Ropsten'

name: get_departures
title: Get departures
